name: Aceprometazine
summary: Aceprometazine (INN) is a phenothiazine derivative prescription drug with neuroleptic and anti-histamine properties It is not widely prescribed, and may be associated with drug-induced Parkinsonism. It may be used in combination with meprobamate for the treatment of sleep disorders. This combination is available in France under the trade name Mepronizine.

uses.text: It may be used in combination with meprobamate for the treatment of sleep disorders. It is structurally related to the phenothiazine derivative veterinary drug acepromazine.

pharmacology.en: Like other phenothiazines, it blocks dopamine D2 receptors and histamine receptors, which produces both antipsychotic and sedating effects.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他吩噻嗪類一樣，它會阻斷多巴胺D2受體與組織胺受體，因而同時產生抗精神病與鎮靜作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他吩噻嗪类一样，它会阻断多巴胺D2受体与组织胺受体，因而同时产生抗精神病与镇静作用。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, dry mouth and low blood pressure on standing. Like other phenothiazines it can cause drug-induced Parkinsonism, with tremor, stiffness and slowed movement.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起嗜睡、口乾與站立時血壓偏低。和其他吩噻嗪類一樣，它可能造成藥物引起的巴金森症狀，包括顫抖、僵硬與動作變慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起嗜睡、口干与站立时血压偏低。和其他吩噻嗪类一样，它可能造成药物引起的巴金森症状，包括颤抖、僵硬与动作变慢。

fact.en: It differs from the familiar antihistamine promethazine by a single acetyl group, which shifts it from a sedating allergy medicine towards an antipsychotic.
fact.zh: 它與常見的抗組織胺異丙嗪（promethazine）只差一個乙醯基，而這個差別讓它從一種會嗜睡的抗過敏藥，轉向抗精神病藥。
fact.zhHans: 它与常见的抗组织胺异丙嗪（promethazine）只差一个乙酰基，而这个差别让它从一种会嗜睡的抗过敏药，转向抗精神病药。
